official.name: razor_plasma_field
official.desc_loc: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
official.lore_loc: The Lightning Revenant rules the Underscape with plasmatic power.

officialZh.name: razor_plasma_field
officialZh.desc_loc: 释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。距离雷泽越远，伤害和减速越高。等离子场对每个单位造成两次伤害。
officialZh.lore_loc: 闪电幽魂用等离子的力量统治着永劫之墟。

official.name: razor_static_link
official.desc_loc: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
official.lore_loc: Razor's polarity channels electricity into his being, draining the power of his opposition.
notes_loc: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.
official.shard_loc: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.

officialZh.name: razor_static_link
officialZh.desc_loc: 在雷泽和敌方英雄之间创造静电连接，偷取目标的攻击力并转移给雷泽。雷泽在连接生效时可以边移动边攻击。
officialZh.lore_loc: 雷泽的极性吸引电流通向自身，以汲取他对手的力量。
notes_loc: 链接在一方单位死亡或双方距离超过%drain_range_buffer%后断裂。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升施法距离。减缓目标的移动速度，数值为连接生效时%move_speed_factor%倍的攻击力窃取量。

official.name: razor_storm_surge
official.desc_loc: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
official.lore_loc: Merely approaching the Lightning Revenant is rewarded with shock therapy.
notes_loc: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
official.shard_loc: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.

officialZh.name: razor_storm_surge
officialZh.desc_loc: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
officialZh.lore_loc: 仅仅是靠近闪电幽魂就会体验免费的电击疗法。
notes_loc: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
officialZh.shard_loc: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为%eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%倍，打击冷却时间减少%strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。

official.name: razor_unstable_current
official.desc_loc: Passively increases Razor's movement speed.

officialZh.name: razor_unstable_current
officialZh.desc_loc: 被动提升雷泽的移动速度。

official.name: razor_eye_of_the_storm
official.desc_loc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
notes_loc: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.
official.scepter_loc: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.

officialZh.name: razor_eye_of_the_storm
officialZh.desc_loc: 强大的闪电风暴，打击生命值最低的敌方单位，造成伤害并削弱护甲。
notes_loc: 每次打击都会以范围内血量最低的敌方单位为目标。
风暴之眼优先打击受到静电连接作用的英雄。
连续施放的风暴之眼可以叠加。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 风暴之眼可以同时打击两个目标，并且能对建筑造成伤害。打击建筑时，只会以防御塔、兵营和遗迹作为目标。

official.name: viper_poison_attack
official.desc_loc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
official.lore_loc: The Netherdrake's inborn toxic breath quickly drains the vitality of its afflicted.
official.shard_loc: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.

officialZh.name: viper_poison_attack
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。效果可以叠加，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冥界亚龙天生带有剧毒的吐息能迅速抽干敌人的生命力。
officialZh.shard_loc: 提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

official.name: viper_nethertoxin
official.desc_loc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
official.lore_loc: Poison from the Nether Reaches turns wounds into fatalities, and fatigue into death.
notes_loc: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.

officialZh.name: viper_nethertoxin
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝮蛇向目标区域释放幽冥剧毒。范围内的单位持续受到伤害，在区域内停留的时间越长，受到的伤害也越高。同时他们的攻击速度会被降低。
officialZh.lore_loc: 三途川的剧毒让小伤也能致死，而疲乏可以送命。
notes_loc: 多个幽冥剧毒不会叠加。

special_values.name: max_duration
special_values.heading_loc: 最高每秒伤害所需时间：

official.name: viper_corrosive_skin
official.desc_loc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a %max_range% radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
official.lore_loc: It is not unusual for sword and shield alike to corrode in the very hands of those who attack the Netherdrake.
notes_loc: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
official.scepter_loc: Corrosive Skin applies %effect_multiplier%x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within %effect_multiplier_distance% distance of Viper.  Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to %nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%% increased effect after %nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%s.

officialZh.name: viper_corrosive_skin
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝮蛇分泌出感染性的毒素，%max_range%范围内任何伤害它的敌人都将受到伤害，同时攻击速度也被降低。这种酸性分泌物还能提高蝮蛇的魔法抗性。
officialZh.lore_loc: 对冥界亚龙出击后，手中的刀剑和盾牌会遭到腐蚀并不稀奇。
notes_loc: 与其他提升魔法抗性的物品和技能叠加。
破坏会使腐蚀皮肤不再施加效果。极恶俯冲还是会施加腐蚀皮肤。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 腐蚀皮肤会对距离冥界亚龙%effect_multiplier_distance%范围内的敌人施加%effect_multiplier%倍攻击速度降低效果。当冥界亚龙处于幽冥剧毒中，腐蚀皮肤的魔法抗性和每秒伤害会逐渐提升，在%nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%秒后，达到最高的%nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%%提升。

official.name: viper_nose_dive
official.desc_loc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.
official.lore_loc: It was thought that Netherdrake wings touch ground only in death, but some surmise that those who've witnessed more intentional landings merely haven't survived to tell the tale.

officialZh.name: viper_nose_dive
officialZh.desc_loc: 冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且%corrosive_radius%范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续%effect_duration%秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。
officialZh.lore_loc: 世人认为冥界亚龙的翅膀只有在死亡时才会碰到地面，不过也有揣测是有人见证了更为刻意的着陆，只是没能活着说出他的故事。

official.name: viper_predator
official.desc_loc: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.

officialZh.name: viper_predator
officialZh.desc_loc: 冥界亚龙的攻击会根据目标英雄缺失的生命百分比额外造成一次物理伤害。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: viper_viper_strike
official.desc_loc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.
official.lore_loc: Once used to slay his sadistic summoner, the most powerful of Netherdrake infections spreads through the veins of those foolish enough to cross Viper.

officialZh.name: viper_viper_strike
officialZh.desc_loc: 蝮蛇降低敌方目标单位的移动和攻击速度，同时<font color='#dd621e'>破坏</font>其被动技能并造成持续毒素伤害。移动和攻击速度会在毒素的持续时间内逐渐恢复。
officialZh.lore_loc: 冥界亚龙身上最具威力的毒素，曾用于屠戮它残酷的主人。不论是谁，只要愚蠢到与蝮蛇作对就会被毒杀。

official.name: abaddon_death_coil
official.desc_loc: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
official.lore_loc: A mysterious vapor from the Font of Avernus now infuses the breath of Abaddon, who releases it at will.
notes_loc: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.
facets_loc: Mist Coil also deals %damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%% attack damage and applies effects from items and abilities. Self Damage increased when targeting enemies.

officialZh.name: abaddon_death_coil
officialZh.desc_loc: 亚巴顿以自身的部分生命为代价，释放出一团致命迷雾，可以对敌方单位造成伤害，或者<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>友方单位。
officialZh.lore_loc: 亚巴顿的气息中充盈着来自魔霭圣池的神秘之汽，他能随意将其释放。
notes_loc: 亚巴顿不能使用此技能自杀。
facets_loc: 迷雾缠绕还会造成%damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%%攻击伤害，并且施加物品和技能的效果。对敌人施放时对自身的伤害增加。

official.name: abaddon_aphotic_shield
official.desc_loc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.
notes_loc: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.
official.shard_loc: %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
facets_loc: Damage barrier amount increased, but no longer bursts upon expiration. %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies. Increases cooldown.

officialZh.name: abaddon_aphotic_shield
officialZh.desc_loc:
召唤黑暗能量环绕友方单位，驱散他们并创造一个<font color='#b97812'>全伤害护盾</font>，<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>在消失前能吸收一定量的伤害。<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>消失或被摧毁后将会爆炸，对附近区域的单位造成伤害，伤害值为<font color='#b97812'>护盾</font>的最大吸收量。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 升腾的黑雾将敌人的招数一一吞噬，如同吞噬日光。
notes_loc: 不论护盾因持续时间结束或吸收足够伤害后被摧毁都将造成最大伤害。
爆炸将不会对战争迷雾内单位造成伤害。
officialZh.shard_loc: 会对附近敌人造成吸收伤害的%absorb_to_damage%%%。
facets_loc: 伤害护盾数值提升，但是护盾被摧毁后不再爆炸。%absorb_to_damage%%%吸收伤害会反弹给附近的敌人。增加冷却时间。

official.name: abaddon_frostmourne
official.desc_loc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by %tower_dps_pct%%%.
official.lore_loc: While the baptized draw strength from the Font, the gifts of Avernus are debilitating to the uninitiated.

officialZh.name: abaddon_frostmourne
officialZh.desc_loc: 亚巴顿打击一个敌人，使其受到寒心诅咒的作用，被减速，并且持续受到伤害，同时所有攻击目标的单位将提升攻击速度。对建筑的持续伤害减少%tower_dps_pct%%%。
officialZh.lore_loc: 受洗之人能从圣池中汲取能量，而魔霭的恩赐会让一无所知的人逐渐衰弱。

official.name: abaddon_withering_mist
official.desc_loc: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for %duration%s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by %heal_reduction_pct%%% if they are below %hp_threshold_pct%%% HP.

officialZh.name: abaddon_withering_mist
officialZh.desc_loc: 对敌人造成伤害时会施加凋零迷雾的负面效果，持续%duration%秒。受作用敌人如果血量低于%hp_threshold_pct%%%，那么生命回复会降低%heal_reduction_pct%%%。

official.name: abaddon_borrowed_time
official.desc_loc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below %hp_threshold%.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
official.lore_loc: The most unnatural of all the gifts of the Font of Avernus, this power defies mortal understanding.  What should hurt, instead heals; and what should kill gives strength anew.
notes_loc: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced.  The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.
official.scepter_loc: Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than %ally_threshold_scepter% damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.
facets_loc: While Borrowed Time is active, Abaddon and enemies within %immolate_aoe% radius take %immolate_damage% damage per second.

officialZh.name: abaddon_borrowed_time
officialZh.desc_loc:
启动后驱散自身，所有受到的伤害转而产生<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果。只要技能不在冷却中，在生命值低于%hp_threshold%点时技能会自动启动。

驱散类型：强驱散
officialZh.lore_loc: 魔霭圣池中最为扭曲的馈赠，凡人对死亡的认知在此力量前显得异常可笑。敌之尖刀，我之伤药；死地后生，回光返照。
notes_loc: 在亚巴顿受到眩晕作用时依然可以手动开启回光返照，但是受到沉默作用时不可以。不过被沉默时被动效果依然能生效。
无光之盾在回光返照生效期间不会吸收伤害，因此也不会影响治疗效果。
破坏会使回光返照无法自动触发。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升持续时间。启动回光返照后，亚巴顿附近迷雾缠绕的施法距离内友方英雄受到的伤害超过%ally_threshold_scepter%点时亚巴顿就会自动对其施放迷雾缠绕。
facets_loc: 回光返照生效时亚巴顿和%immolate_aoe%范围内的敌人每秒会受到%immolate_damage%点伤害。

official.name: slardar_sprint
official.desc_loc: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
official.lore_loc: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.
notes_loc: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.
facets_loc: Slardar has slow resistance and even more movement speed at the beginning of Guardian Sprint.

officialZh.name: slardar_sprint
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯拉达向前蜿行，移动速度得到显著提升，并且可以穿越单位。在最初%speed_burst_max_duration%内斯拉达获得%slow_resistance_tooltip%%%<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>。<font color='#9ec8e3'>减速抗性</font>会在剩余的冲刺时间内逐渐衰减。
officialZh.lore_loc: 斯拉达从深海来到陆地后，发现有必要用强有力的尾巴冲刺来代替游泳。
notes_loc: 开启此技能不会打断持续施法。
facets_loc: 守卫冲刺开始时斯拉达获得减速抗性和额外的移动速度。

official.name: slardar_slithereen_crush
official.desc_loc: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
official.lore_loc: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.
official.shard_loc: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
official.scepter_loc: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.

officialZh.name: slardar_slithereen_crush
officialZh.desc_loc: 猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
officialZh.lore_loc: 强力的快速碎击，溅起的水浪打破最坚固的防御。
officialZh.shard_loc: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 提升鱼人碎击水洼的作用范围和持续时间。

official.name: slardar_bash
official.desc_loc: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
official.lore_loc: Thieves of the wealth of the Deep Ones meet the brutality of the Slithereen Guard in melee combat.
notes_loc: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

officialZh.name: slardar_bash
officialZh.desc_loc: %attack_count%次攻击后，下次攻击会<font color='#2dd5e4'>重击</font>目标。
officialZh.lore_loc: 偷窃深海一族宝藏的盗贼在近身战斗中遇到了鱼人守卫的残暴之力。
notes_loc: 不能与碎颅锤叠加。

official.name: slardar_seaborn_sentinel
official.desc_loc: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
official.scepter_loc: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by %scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%% and puddle/trail duration by %scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%s.

officialZh.name: slardar_seaborn_sentinel
officialZh.desc_loc: 斯拉达在水洼、水迹或河道中将获得移动速度、生命恢复、攻击力和护甲加成。
officialZh.scepter_loc: 在水洼、水迹或河道中获得额外生命恢复、护甲，还有<font color='#b99012'>状态抗性</font>。水洼/水迹的作用范围提升%scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%%，水洼的持续时间提升%scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%秒。

abilities.iconVerification: Valve frontend generic innate icon fallback; individual URL remains 404

official.name: slardar_amplify_damage
official.desc_loc: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
official.lore_loc: Even the strongest armor counts for little when left to the brine of the sea.
facets_loc: Corrosive Haze increases Slardar's armor by %armor_pct%%% of the total armor reduced.

officialZh.name: slardar_amplify_damage
officialZh.desc_loc: 削弱敌人的护甲，加深他受到的物理伤害，同时提供目标的真实视域，显示<font color='#d7ccc7'>隐身</font>单位。敌方单位将在身后留下水迹。
officialZh.lore_loc: 即使是最坚硬的铠甲，一旦遇到海水也是不堪一击。
facets_loc: 斯拉达的护甲提升，数值为侵蚀雾霭降低护甲总数的%armor_pct%%%。
